clue.text: Real information Independent put in French article

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: put in says one piece is placed inside another, here the letter going into the article

parts.note: une is the French feminine indefinite article, 'a'

explanation.surface: A news item from the Independent newspaper gets reprinted in a French piece, and is vouched for as real.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put in' makes UINE; GEN is informal British for information, as in 'get the gen'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something genuine is authentic, the real thing rather than a fake.

clue.text: Cheers advantageous purchase, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the phrase is heard spoken, sounding like another word

parts.note: a good buy is a bargain, something bought to advantage

explanation.surface: A shopper toasting a bargain with a cheerful drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheers' is informal British for goodbye as well as thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain cheers is an informal farewell, a casual way to take leave.

clue.text: More agreeable French Riviera city river

parts.note: Nice is a city on the French Riviera

explanation.surface: A traveller finds the river at a Riviera city pleasanter.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicer is the comparative of nice, meaning pleasanter.

clue.text: In dialect novel's the same

indicators.note: novel's here means novel is, new and fresh, telling us the letters take a new order

explanation.surface: A reader notes a book written in dialect reads just like another.
explanation.definitionFit: Identical things match exactly, with no difference between them.

clue.text: Run over

definitions.meaning: in cricket an ... is a run scored not off the bat, such as a wide or bye
over can mean ..., left over or in excess

explanation.surface: A cricket call, or a jogger overshooting.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, an over is six balls and extras are runs not hit by the batter.
explanation.definitionFit: An extra is a cricket run, and extra also means surplus, beyond what is needed.

clue.text: More powerful shredder, we're told

indicators.note: we're told signals that the word is heard spoken rather than read, so it sounds like another

parts.note: a grater is a kitchen tool that shreds cheese or vegetables

explanation.surface: An advert boasting that a kitchen shredder is more powerful than its rivals.
explanation.definitionFit: Greater strength or force makes something stronger, the comparative of great.

clue.text: Assurance of dancing septuagenarian, lacking various pains

indicators.note: dancing suggests the letters of the long word jig about into a new order
lacking means certain letters are left out of the long word's pool
various suggests the letters to be removed appear in any order

explanation.surface: A dancing seventy-year-old is promised freedom from aches and pains.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove P, A, I, N, S from SEPTUAGENARIAN in any order and rearrange the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A guarantee is a formal promise or pledge that something will happen.

clue.text: Stand and comfort student

parts.note: ease means comfort, freedom from strain
L is for learner, as on a British learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A student told to stand up and be at ease.
explanation.definitionFit: An easel is a frame that holds a painter's canvas upright.

clue.text: Anxious quivering started, not oddly, over male with expensive jewellery

indicators.note: over in a down clue means sitting above, so the picked letters come first
not oddly means skipping the odd letters of started and keeping the even ones

parts.note: bling is slang for showy, expensive jewellery

explanation.surface: A nervous wreck shaking as a man in flashy jewellery approaches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not oddly' keeps the 2nd, 4th and 6th letters of started: TRE.
explanation.definitionFit: Trembling describes shaking with fear or nerves, the anxious quiver of the clue.

clue.text: Lighten burden, enjoy life again embracing energy

indicators.note: embracing means holding around, so energy goes within the word for living again

parts.note: to relive is to experience again
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Advice to shed one's load and find new zest.
explanation.definitionFit: To relieve someone is to ease their load or take some weight off them.

clue.text: Players and artist going after gold box

indicators.note: going after places the artist's letters behind the gold and box

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
a chest is a large box
RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword staple for artist

explanation.surface: A painter chasing a gold-filled box, perhaps a treasure hunt, with players somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchestra is a body of musicians, so a collective name for players of instruments.

clue.text: Reportedly take construction material

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said, so the word for take is heard and spelt differently

parts.note: to steal is to take without permission

explanation.surface: A rumour that someone made off with building supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: Steel girders and beams are a chief structural material in modern building.

clue.text: Inflamed with passion only involving the navy

indicators.note: involving means taking something in, so the navy goes inside the word for only

parts.note: but can mean only, as in 'but a child'
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A sailor's romance: passion that only flares where the navy is involved.
explanation.definitionFit: Burnt is the past participle of burn, used figuratively for being consumed by fierce desire.

clue.text: At one's disposal, one dog in American valley

indicators.note: in places the one and the dog inside the American valley

parts.note: a vale is a valley
one is the Roman numeral I
lab is short for Labrador, a dog breed

explanation.surface: A single dog roaming an American valley, ready for whoever wants it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' makes VAILABLE; LAB is short for Labrador.
explanation.definitionFit: Available things can be used or had freely, ready for whoever needs them.

clue.text: Fence I fit clumsily is working competently

indicators.note: clumsily suggests the letters of these words are put together awkwardly, out of order

explanation.surface: A DIY boast that despite clumsy fitting, the new fence does its job.
explanation.definitionFit: Efficient describes something functioning well, achieving results without wasted effort.

clue.text: In favour of president hugging Democrat: it's banned

parts.note: for means in support of

indicators.note: hugging means wrapping round, so the president surrounds the Democrat letter

parts.note: Joe Biden was the 46th US president

explanation.surface: Political embraces deemed off-limits for a party loyalist.
explanation.definitionFit: Forbidden means not allowed, prohibited by rule or law.

clue.text: Eastern movement a Liberal worked up

parts.note: motion means movement

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician agitated by an eastern political movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone emotional is stirred up, agitated by strong feelings.

clue.text: Orchard's foremost thriving tree

indicators.note: foremost picks out the front letter of the word Orchard's

parts.note: live can mean active and thriving, full of life

explanation.surface: The best tree in the orchard is flourishing.
explanation.definitionFit: The olive is a Mediterranean evergreen grown for its fruit and oil.

clue.text: Possession when pro is involved

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters of these words are intertwined anew

explanation.surface: A legal point: who owns something once a professional gets involved.
explanation.definitionFit: Ownership is the state of having something as one's property.

clue.text: Substance found in an offshore bank?

definitions.text: Substance found in an offshore bank?

parts.words: Substance found in an offshore bank?
parts.note: a bank here is not a financial one but a reef or shoal in the sea, built from a hard marine substance

explanation.surface: Money squirrelled away in a tax-haven account.
explanation.walkthrough: 'offshore bank' suggests tax havens, but it is a sandbank-like reef under the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Coral is the hard skeletal material of tiny marine animals, forming reefs and banks.

clue.text: Estimating the price of business do

parts.note: Co is short for company, a business
to do someone is to cheat them, and a sting is a confidence trick

explanation.surface: Working out the bill for a company party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'do' looks like a party but means a swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: Costing something means calculating what it will cost.

clue.text: Mistake having a change of heart very quickly

indicators.note: change of heart means the central letter of the word for mistake is swapped for another

parts.note: an oversight is a mistake made through not noticing

explanation.surface: Someone realises an error and changes their mind straight away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having a change of heart' swaps the middle S of OVERSIGHT for N.
explanation.definitionFit: Overnight success comes suddenly, as if happening in a single night, so it means rapidly.

clue.text: New threat over English playhouse

indicators.note: over in a down clue places the shuffled letters above the next piece
new suggests these letters are made over into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A fresh menace hangs over an English venue.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre is a building where plays are staged.

clue.text: Inform about tiny person sewing

indicators.note: about means going round, so the word for inform surrounds the small person

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing to the police
titch is British slang for a very small person

explanation.surface: Telling tales on a small person caught sewing.
explanation.walkthrough: TITCH is British informal for a small person, often a child.
explanation.definitionFit: Stitching is the act of making stitches with needle and thread.

clue.text: Carry in triumph from public display after check

indicators.note: after places the display word behind the check

parts.note: ch is the chess abbreviation for check
to give something an airing is to show it in public, so air means display

explanation.surface: A victor paraded through the streets after a final check.
explanation.definitionFit: To chair a hero is to lift them shoulder-high and carry them aloft.

clue.text: Micro-organisms carried at heart in precious stones

indicators.note: in places that central letter inside the precious stones

parts.note: gems are precious stones

indicators.note: at heart picks out the central letter of carried

explanation.surface: Microbes found lurking within carried jewels.
explanation.definitionFit: Germs are microbes, especially those that cause disease.

clue.text: Some opera is expected to elate

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An opera-goer's hope that the performance will lift the spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise someone's spirits is to cheer them, the sense of elate here.

clue.text: Mental picture of one learned person

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
a mage is a wise man or scholar

explanation.surface: A scholar's visualisation of an idea.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a representation formed in the mind.

clue.text: Ian heartlessly sent back aid for eastern country

indicators.note: heartlessly takes the middle letter out of the name Ian
sent back means the word aid is read from right to left

explanation.surface: Cold-hearted Ian returns aid meant for an eastern nation.
explanation.definitionFit: India is a large nation in South Asia, east of Europe.

clue.text: Point represented another way

indicators.note: represented means presented again in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A debating move: making the same point but expressed differently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'represented' yields NORTHEA; 'way' is the street abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Northeast is one of the compass points, midway between north and east.

clue.text: Widespread in related species on lake

indicators.note: on means following, so the lake comes after the species

parts.note: genera are biological groups of closely related species

explanation.surface: A naturalist noting something common among related species living by a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: General means common to most or affecting all, the opposite of specific.

clue.text: Most excellent meat dish

definitions.meaning: highest in quality, the very best
a dish of chicken breast, often in a cream sauce

explanation.surface: A restaurant review praising the finest meat course.
explanation.definitionFit: Supreme means best of all, and chicken supreme is a classic dish.
